evidence: All surviving solutions immediately search for and print a witness; none has a no-witness path. The traces rely on the promise, including loops that end at the first found triangle.
affordance_in_statement: It is guaranteed that the conflict data contains at least one group of three workers where each worker in the group conflicts with both of the other two.
removal_suggestion: Do not present the existence of a triangle as an explicit early-search promise. Instead, describe the data as a hopeless roster and state that adversarial instances may place the lexicographically smallest valid group after essentially all earlier candidates; retain the same required output and examples.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Its bitset implementation contains an incorrect or incomplete neighbor-index/triangle-check implementation, as indicated by the malformed/truncated bitset traversal around the shifted-neighbor calculation.

recommended_edit: Replace the direct statement that a triangle is guaranteed with an indirect adversarial-instance description: clarify that the lexicographically smallest valid group can occur only after all earlier candidate triples have been rejected. This preserves the task, bounds, input/output formats, tie-break rule, and examples while forcing the surviving naive searches to perform their worst-case enumeration.
regression_risk: The edit mainly targets runtime; it could restore gpt-oss-120b only if its bitset indexing bug is independently corrected, but it should not restore the currently defeated version.
